Nicole’s Journey

Love Knows No Distance

In loving memory of
Nicole Lee Spaulding

1981 – 2026

Every journey begins with a connection. This one begins with a mother’s love, a son’s memories and a new connection across the oceans.

Exploring Hervey Bay, Australia

Why this journey is special

Nicole’s Journey is a special geocaching traveller created in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Australia, with the permission of her son, Kirk. The humpback whale and dingo on the tag represent the Australian home from which this little tribute will begin.

Through photographs, stories, beautiful places and unexpected friendships, we hope to carry Nicole’s memory across the world, while exploring the connections that bring us together. Perhaps one day, this traveller might even find a connection to Kevin Bacon himself.

Across the oceans

Hervey BayQueensland, Australia
WareMassachusetts, USA

Planned first overseas journey. The memorial tag has now been printed and laminated and has begun exploring Hervey Bay. It has not yet been posted overseas.

Nicole’s travel diary

26 November 2026 · Australia

Where it all begins

A special memorial tag was designed in Hervey Bay. Kirk kindly gave permission for a page to be created in Nicole’s memory, so her family and fellow geocachers can follow the journey as it unfolds.

27 November 2026 · A connection across the oceans

Nicole’s story begins to travel

Before the little memorial tag has even left Australia, Kirk Floyd has shared its design with the geocaching community in the Facebook group Cache Me If You Can......, announcing his participation in the Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon Challenge.

“I am honored to join the challenge.”

Thank you, Kirk, for sharing Nicole’s tribute and being part of this adventure. While the ultimate dream is to reach Kevin Bacon, every new connection, story and photograph will be a meaningful part of this journey.

The physical tag is still being prepared. This is the first recorded community milestone, not a travel or geocache log.

28 November 2026 · Hervey Bay, Queensland, Australia

From Australia, With Love

Today, Nicole’s travelling tribute began exploring our little corner of Australia. We visited Stormwater Lookout, and before heading to the beach, stopped beside a beautiful pink rose blooming in my front garden — a gentle symbol of love and remembrance.

Later, at Gatakers Bay, we captured moments among the coastal trees, golden sand, little paw prints and the sparkling waters of Hervey Bay. Before this special tribute crosses oceans, I wanted to share a few pieces of my world with Nicole’s family and everyone following her adventure.

May each new destination bring another memory, and every act of kindness carry her story a little further.

If you find Nicole’s Journey

Please log your discovery on Geocaching.com, share a photograph or story if you wish, and help the tag continue to another suitable geocache. If you have a connection to film, television or Kevin Bacon, we would love to hear about it.

Please keep the unique tracking code out of public photographs and posts.
